# Layouts

Page layouts for my, built from the components in this system. Each has a live card in **Components › Layouts** (both themes, PC 1280px and phone 390px) with its full guidelines; the pictures below are Light-theme snapshots.

## Shared rules

- Breakpoints: PC ≥1120px (three columns: 260px rail, feed ≤640px, 300px aside), tablet 700–1119px (the aside goes), phone <700px (one column and a 64px bottom tab bar).
- The app's left rail holds the wordmark, the RailItems, the one 「投稿する」 button and the account. Logged-out pages (landing, info) use a light top bar instead.
- Nothing is fixed over content except the phone's bottom tab bar and, on the timeline, the small new-posts pill.
- One primary action per view.

## Landing — LayoutLanding

The logged-out entry: top bar (サーバーについて, ルール, ログイン, **アカウントを作成**), a cream hero with a serif headline and two real local posts, three feature cards, the latest local posts, footer.

![Landing page, PC and phone](data:image/jpeg;base64,)

## Info page — LayoutInfoPage

Server information, rules, terms and privacy as one reading column (680px) with a sticky table of contents on PC. Identical signed in or out except the top-right button.

![Info page, PC and phone](data:image/jpeg;base64,)

## Timeline — LayoutTimeline

No header bar and no inline composer, so the newest post is always the first thing in the column. Tabs scroll away with the posts; writing opens a Dialog (PC) or Sheet (phone) from 「投稿する」, the tab bar's coral button or `n`. New posts are inserted at the top without moving the post being read; a small 「12件の新しい投稿」 pill appears only while the reader is away from the top. Keep a pause setting for auto-update (WCAG 2.2.2).

![Timeline page, PC and phone](data:image/jpeg;base64,)

## Settings — LayoutSettings

A sticky section menu beside one pane; switches and selects save at once and confirm with 「保存しました」. On phones the menu is its own page and each section opens with a 「← 設定」 back link.

![Settings page, PC and phone](data:image/jpeg;base64,)

## Admin — LayoutAdmin

A separate mode with its own sidebar (counts as danger Badges, 「アプリに戻る」 at the bottom), a filter toolbar, a table beside a sticky detail card, and pagination. Irreversible actions always go through a ConfirmDialog with a reason.

![Admin page, PC and phone](data:image/jpeg;base64,)
